distribution.narrative: Zhang et al. (2021) described Scolytus jiulianshanensis from Jiulianshan National Nature Reserve, Ganzhou, Jiangxi, China. The species is known in the source only from this type locality, establishing confirmed mainland-China occurrence in Jiangxi.

host_note: The original description explicitly reports the species from dead elm and lists the host as Ulmus sp. The host is retained at genus level; the dead-tree condition is ecological context and is not used to infer a species-level host.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Scolytus jiulianshanensis Zhang, Li & Smith, 2021.

taxonomic_history.name: Scolytus jiulianshanensis
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: Scolytus jiulianshanensis Zhang, Li & Smith was described as a new species in 2021. This original-description evidence maps directly to the pre-existing integrated taxonomic backbone identity VSN_5511; no duplicate VSN is created.
